notablePrerequisites: Stone-Seeder Hierophant does not have summoning sickness.
description:
Activate Lotus Field by tapping it, adding {3}.
Activate Stone-Seeder Hierophant by tapping it, untapping Lotus Field.
Activate Drownyard Temple by paying {3}, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield tapped.
Drownyard Temple enters the battlefield, triggering Stone-Seeder Hierophant, untapping Stone-Seeder Hierophant.
Activate Zuran Orb by sacrificing Drownyard Temple, causing you to gain two life.
Repeat.
